open_points.subject: Derived work-balance presentation
open_points.text: State 0 says work balance is shown as “Completed ahead of payments” or “Unused advance payment”, “or as balanced when it is zero”; State 1 still says it is “presented as `Completed ahead of payments` / `Unused advance payment`” without the zero-balance presentation.
open_points.question: When completed work value exactly equals received payments, must the derived view present the distinct `balanced` state, or must it use only one of the two directional presentations listed in the unchanged State 1 passage?
options: Present `balanced` when the balance is zero.
Use only `Completed ahead of payments` or `Unused advance payment`, including at zero.
open_points.default_guess: Present `balanced` when the balance is zero, consistent with the changed State 0 text and `WorkBalanceLabel`.

witness.initial: An active project has completed work value of EUR 1,000 and received work payments totaling EUR 1,000.
events: A viewer or authorized staff member reads the project's payment summary.
outcomes: The response carries the distinct `balanced` label.
The response carries one of the two directional labels because the State 1 derived-values passage defines only those presentations.
witness.observer: The viewer or staff caller reading the payment summary.
